_readme: Cloud/endpoint definitions consumed by the Entra-TCG scripts (Apply-GraphTemplate.ps1, Start-CommunitySync.ps1, Initialize-TcgDeployerApp.ps1). Each key under 'clouds' is an -Environment name. To add a cloud offline, copy an entry, rename the key, and fill in the four fields: graphEndpoint (Microsoft Graph base URL / token audience), loginHost (OIDC login host), mgEnvironment (Microsoft.Graph SDK environment name), azCloud (Azure CLI cloud name for 'az cloud set'). Global/USGov/USGovDoD are also built into the scripts as a fallback; entries here override the built-in of the same name.
